svg.text: PostgreSQL (Supabase) · server/sql/schema.sql · 16 tables · times stored as ISO-8601 UTC text, dates as YYYY-MM-DD
PK primary key FK foreign key UQ unique
? = nullable ||— one ≺ many o| zero or one
Standalone tables · no foreign keys; linked by value (e.g. audit_log.actor_id, roster_publications.week_start, payroll_runs.period_start)

ON DELETE CASCADE from users → user_roles, sessions, notifications and from employees → roster_shifts, time_entries, leave_requests. audit_log has a trigger that blocks UPDATE and DELETE. Row Level Security is enabled on every table.
